summary: This bill requires the NSF Director to submit to Congress within 18 months a detailed plan assessing the cybersecurity and telecommunications needs of the U.S. Academic Research Fleet, estimating upgrade costs and timelines, and outlining funding sources, while authorizing support for such upgrades and requiring a follow-up implementation report after two years.

scores.thoughts: This bill focuses on improving cybersecurity and telecommunications for the U.S. Academic Research Fleet, including assessing cybersecurity needs, network capabilities, and international standards for information security. This directly relates to enhancing data protection and security within a specific domain.
